## Description and Rationale

I am an independent participant based in the United Kingdom with a strong interest in aviation data, analytics and machine learning. I joined the PRC Data Challenge to work with real-world aviation data, test different analytical and modelling approaches, and improve my understanding of operational performance and air traffic data. The challenge is also an opportunity to learn from the wider research and aviation data community and develop practical, data-driven solutions.

## Details
